definitions.explanation: A sign or status indicating that equipment, facilities, or systems are currently being inspected or maintained.

examples.japanese: エレベーターは{点検中|てんけんちゅう}です。
「{点検中|てんけんちゅう}」の{札|ふだ}がかかっている。
{設備|せつび}が{点検中|てんけんちゅう}のため{使用|しよう}できません。
examples.english: The facilities are unavailable due to inspection.

notes:
{点検中|てんけんちゅう} is composed of {点検|てんけん} (inspection/checking) + {中|ちゅう} (in progress). It appears on signs when equipment, elevators, restrooms, or facilities are temporarily unavailable due to maintenance or inspection.

THE ～{中|ちゅう} PATTERN:
The suffix {中|ちゅう} attaches to action nouns to indicate something is currently in progress. Other common examples:
- {清掃中|せいそうちゅう}: cleaning in progress
- {工事中|こうじちゅう}: under construction
- {故障中|こしょうちゅう}: out of order
- {準備中|じゅんびちゅう}: in preparation
- {営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}: open for business

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {点検中|てんけんちゅう}のため{使用|しよう}できません: unavailable due to inspection
- 「{点検中|てんけんちゅう}」の{表示|ひょうじ}: an "under inspection" notice
- {定期|ていき}{点検中|てんけんちゅう}: undergoing regular inspection
